scripts.lint: npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && npm run lint:part --workspaces --include-workspace-root --
scripts.typecheck:tests: npm run build -w @hornhoof/protocol && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/node/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node scripts/check-release.mjs --local && npm run test:release && npm run typecheck:tests && npm test --workspaces --if-present
